Can you confirm:

Emma — great questions, thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then a suggested MAP update:

1) Final yes/no to reserve the Dedicated pool: we need that 10 business days before your desired day-zero to guarantee the GPU pool and onboarding slot. For example, for a 2027-05-03 start we'd need a signed SOW by 2027-04-19.

2) DocuSign turnaround: typical straight-through is 24–48 hours once procurement approves the final SOW; with redlines it'll be 2–5 business days depending on legal review. We can pre-seed DocuSign to minimize serial delays.

3) Earliest realistic start date: assuming the MAP eval runs on the schedule we discussed (2-week pilot + 1-week stabilization), earliest day-one would be ~3.5 weeks after signature for standard onboarding. If you want compressed ramp with a dedicated onboarding team, we can target 10 business days from signature (but that requires confirmed shipping of tokens and initial access earlier in the week).

Attached: BlueLeaf_MAP_v3.pdf (map with updated approval milestones) and a draft SOW (SOW_BlueLeaf_v1.2.docx). I highlighted the go/no-go gate (M4) and the date cutoffs for reserving capacity.

Proposed next steps:
- Kimberly (legal) to take point on an accelerated review path if BlueLeaf shares redlines today.
- Laura (CS) to lock an onboarding anchor and tentative day-one options (week of 2027-05-03 or week of 2027-05-17).
- BlueLeaf to confirm procurement SLA and preferred signers so we can populate DocuSign.

Happy to hop on call tomorrow 9–11 PT if that helps.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP & final decision window — SOW redlines and signature options

Emma / Tom — looping in Legal (me) to confirm a practical path to sign-off. I reviewed SOW_BlueLeaf_v1.2 and added three narrow redlines: data retention language, SLAs around inference availability, and the liability cap threshold. All are marked in the Word comments.

Options to keep your timeline intact:
- Option A (preferred for speed): We accept your data-retention proposal with a short addendum (one-page) and pre-seed DocuSign with a conditional acceptance clause. This keeps the 24–48 hour execution window if procurement approves.
- Option B: Full redline back-and-forth — expect 3–5 business days for review.

Karthik — if BlueLeaf confirms Option A, I can prepare the addendum and pre-populate DocuSign today. Also noting the M4 go/no-go cutoff Kimberly flagged in the MAP: if signature slips beyond 2027-04-19 we’ll need to move the onboarding slot by a week to the right. If you want, we can provision a temporary hold on capacity for 72 hours while procurement completes final checks (courtesy hold).

Laura — can you tentatively reserve the onboarding anchor for week-of 2027-05-03 and the alternate week-of 2027-05-17? We will convert to firm once DocuSign completes.

Thanks — kim
